title: Modernize Home slider designs and replace icons with more realistic visuals

requirements.text: Update the Home banner carousel to use improved, more modern slide designs while keeping exactly 3 slides (Ludo, Chess, Carrom) and keeping the existing banner image filenames/paths used by the carousel component.

quotes: Need slides with more designs and above picture content not be good kindly change realistic picture of icon with more modern

acceptanceCriteria: The Home banner carousel still shows exactly 3 slides (Ludo, Chess, Carrom) and continues to auto-rotate and allow manual navigation (arrows + dots).

The carousel continues to reference these exact paths: /assets/generated/home-banner-ludo.dim_1600x600.png, /assets/generated/home-banner-chess.dim_1600x600.png, /assets/generated/home-banner-carrom.dim_1600x600.png.
The new banner images look more realistic and modern than the current ones (no cartoonish/flat placeholders).

requirements.text: Replace the HomeScreen game icon images for Ludo, Chess, and Carrom with more realistic, modern-looking icons while keeping the existing icon image filenames/paths used by HomeScreen.

quotes: change realistic picture of icon with more modern

acceptanceCriteria: HomeScreen continues to reference these exact paths: /assets/generated/ludo-icon.dim_512x512.png, /assets/generated/chess-icon.dim_512x512.png, /assets/generated/carrom-icon.dim_512x512.png.
The updated icon images are visually realistic/modern and render correctly in the "All Games" grid cards without layout breakage.

requirements.text: Update the Quick Play section visuals to better match the uploaded reference image (IMG_20260217_142015.jpg) by using the new realistic game icons (image-based) instead of the current Lucide vector icons, while preserving the existing Quick Play titles/subtitle text and the onSelectGame(game) behavior.

quotes: Need slides with more designs and above picture content not be good kindly change realistic picture of icon with more modern

acceptanceCriteria: Quick Play buttons still navigate correctly using the existing onSelectGame(game) flow for ludo/chess/carrom.
Quick Play tiles display image icons for Ludo/Chess/Carrom (using the existing generated icon assets) rather than Lucide icons.
The Quick Play section keeps English user-facing text (e.g., "Quick Play" and "Jump straight into your favorite game").
Quick Play layout remains a 3-item grid and stays visually consistent across common breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop).

constraints: Do not add Cricket back into the UI/navigation.
Do not change the number of Home banner slides (must remain exactly 3: Ludo, Chess, Carrom).
Keep the existing static asset filenames/paths already referenced in code so the UI updates without changing navigation or gameplay.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: No changes to game rules, physics, or gameplay behavior for Ludo/Chess/Carrom.
No backend/state schema changes or data migrations.
No new game modes or multiplayer/real-time features.

required: Modern, realistic banner image with a premium look (home-banner-ludo.dim_1600x600.png)
Modern, realistic banner image with a premium look (home-banner-chess.dim_1600x600.png)
Modern, realistic banner image with a premium look (home-banner-carrom.dim_1600x600.png)
